description: Create an Airflow DAG for saas_metrics that loads usage data for about 40 tenants using dynamic task mapping, where one tenant's failure must not block the others. The DAG should: (1) list active tenants, (2) map 'load_tenant' over them with max_active_tis_per_dag=8, (3) run 'summarize' with trigger_rule='all_done' to collect which tenants succeeded or failed, (4) run 'refresh_global_dashboard' only if at least 90% of tenants succeeded, (5) fail the DAG run if any tenant failed, after the dashboard decision has been made.

schema.source: tenant databases listed in control.tenants (is_active = true)

expected_behavior.final_status_task: raises if any mapped instance failed

edge_cases: Mapped task results from failed instances are absent from XCom; success must be determined from task instance states, not from the length of the returned list alone
Zero active tenants yields a mapped task with zero instances (skipped); summarize must handle this without division by zero
The dashboard must exclude tenants that failed today rather than show stale values labelled as today's
The final status task must run after the dashboard so that a partial failure still refreshes it but the run is red
Tenant list must be evaluated at run time (task), not at parse time
common_failure_modes: FM6: all_done summarize as the leaf turns every partial failure into a green DAG run
FM3: Success ratio computed over successful results only (always 100%)
FM7: Dashboard mixes today's tenants with yesterday's rows for failed tenants without a freshness flag
